limitations.details: ENV-050 (50 stocks), ENV-100 (97 stocks). Both are subsets of S&P 500.
limitations.concern: Limited cross-sectional diversity. Sector representation may be skewed.
limitations.impact_on_research: Limits ability to detect cross-sectional patterns requiring broad diversification

limitations.details: DS-EXP-050/100 use current constituents — survivorship bias possible for pre-2020 delistings
limitations.concern: Delisted stocks excluded from early periods may bias results upward
limitations.impact_on_research: Minor for most features; more concerning for fundamental features (Phase 12D/12E)

limitations.details: Train starts 2010. 14 years of history (2010-2024) split into train/val/test.
limitations.concern: Pre-2010 data not available — misses GFC, dot-com bust
limitations.impact_on_research: Limits ability to test across multiple complete market cycles

limitations.details: Delisted stocks not included in universe composition
Dividends, splits, and other corporate actions handled in data construction
limitations.impact_on_research: Already addressed in LAB-006 label correction

limitations.details: Equal-weight universe median used as benchmark
limitations.concern: Does not account for market cap weighting or sector neutrality
limitations.impact_on_research: Minor — label may capture sector effects rather than pure stock selection

limitations.details: FRED macro data used with same-day release assumption. Macro releases have specific timing (e.g., CPI first Friday, NFP first Friday).
limitations.concern: Look-ahead bias possible if macro data not aligned with correct release dates
limitations.impact_on_research: Could invalidate H-3 macro regime results if macro data release dates not handled correctly
limitations.note: Phase 15.2 did not audit macro release timing alignment

limitations.details: Fundamental data frequency is quarterly with reporting lag (45-90 days). Phase 12D/12E used COMP (Compustat) with lags.
limitations.concern: Quarterly fundamentals are low-frequency relative to 5-day prediction horizon
limitations.impact_on_research: Fundamental features may be better suited to longer horizons (monthly/quarterly)

limitations.details: Daily OHLCV for all assets. Monthly macro data. Quarterly fundamentals.
limitations.concern: Multi-frequency data requires careful temporal alignment
limitations.impact_on_research: Feature construction must handle mixed frequencies correctly

limitations.details: ENV-050 has ~49K observations. ENV-100 has ~97K. H-3 macro features tested with ridge/lasso.
limitations.concern: Sample size adequate for linear models but may be insufficient for complex nonlinear interactions with macro features
limitations.impact_on_research: Limits model complexity for macro-dependent hypotheses

limitations.details: No options or derivatives data available
limitations.concern: Cannot test implied volatility, volatility risk premium, or options-based signals
limitations.impact_on_research: Excludes entire information domain from research

limitations.details: No earnings surprise, analyst revisions, or earnings calendar data
limitations.concern: Cannot test post-earnings drift, analyst expectation changes
limitations.impact_on_research: Excludes fundamental information domain from research

limitations.details: No Level 2, order book, or tick data
limitations.concern: Cannot test liquidity dynamics, order flow imbalance, market microstructure

overall_summary.verdict: ORBIT has sufficient OHLCV, macro, and sector data for most analyses. However, critical gaps exist in options, earnings, and order flow data. These are structural limitations that cannot be resolved through feature engineering.
